structures.overall_structure: Twin grain microstructure in C21000 brass (gilding metal): a few large grains containing long, straight parallel-sided twin lamellae; twin grains characterized by straight or planar boundaries and contrasting regions.

phases_present.morphology: few large grains containing long, straight parallel-sided twin lamellae

interfaces.interface_notes: Twin grains are characterized by straight or planar boundaries and contrasting regions; the twin lamellae are long, straight and parallel-sided.

characterization_methods.purpose: Acquire the twin-grain micrograph of C21000 brass (gilding metal) for microstructure extraction.
characterization_methods.key_findings: Orange/pink optical micrograph of a few large grains containing long, straight parallel-sided twin lamellae.

characterization_methods.technique: MatSAM (training-free microstructure segmentation based on Segment Anything Model)
characterization_methods.purpose: Segment and extract the twin-grain (twin lamellae) microstructure of C21000 brass without manual annotations.
characterization_methods.key_findings: MatSAM's overlay colours the whole grains, and its binary/key-structure panel extracts the twin lamellae as elongated white strips.

computational_details.simulation_method: MatSAM training-free microstructure segmentation (built on Segment Anything Model with structure-aware prompt point generation)

analytical_models.model_name: Morphological feature filtering to isolate twin grains
analytical_models.model_note: For brass micrographs, parameters like circularity, contour geometry, area, and grayscale range were calculated for each mask; by setting tailored filtering conditions, elongated twin grains are effectively distinguished.

unmapped_findings: C21000 brass (gilding metal) twin grain is one of six extended-experiment micrographs (Fig. 10(f)) referenced as [50]; unlike the annotated in-house datasets, this image sample is not provided with corresponding annotations.

For brass micrographs (including C21000), MatSAM's segmentation requires additional post-processing/morphological filtering to isolate elongated twin grains (as demonstrated in Fig. 11(b)); parameters such as circularity, contour geometry, area, and grayscale range are calculated per mask.
The C21000 micrograph is an orange/pink optical micrograph; MatSAM's overlay colours whole grains and its binary/key-structure panel extracts the twin lamellae as elongated white strips.
